time_semantics.dispatch: Original RPC time and selected action; counts include all four sites.
time_semantics.process: Physical first-in/first-out intervals, not recorder visibility timestamps. Mass allocated to 10-minute bins by interval overlap at constant rate within each event.
time_semantics.scope: One descriptive complete shift. Lags combine observed travel, loading, queues and FIFO as labeled. No counterfactual effect or intent is inferred from the trajectory.
time_semantics.signed_metal_surplus: Each contribution is metal_tons minus 0.27 times ore tons.
time_semantics.unload: Physical arrival and deposit at the crusher FIFO; ore only.

selection.criterion: Minimum Euclidean distance from the four conditional cohort medians after IQR scaling. Exclude a dimension with zero IQR. Break ties by run_index.
selection.universe: All 100 sealed fixed mixed-u32 joint_shift validation shifts in the bound report.
